utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: And the other person who I call a source, and not a witness, is because no statement was taken from that person. I have to add that had I recalled that it was marked "people" on the aerial imagery I would not even have referred to the two other people, human sources.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Ostojic? Shall we leave it at that?

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: For the time being we may, Your Honour but I'm not satisfied at all with his answer, quite candidly.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Let's take it up after the break again. 25 minutes from now. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So let's take it up from where we left it. There were about two persons, a woman that you said you can trace her name and make it available. Please try to do that. And when you find out the name, please let us know it. And in the meantime, if you will have finished with your testimony, make sure you inform Mr. McCloskey about the name. And the other gentleman who is a Bosnian Serb army person who was in the Bosnian Serb army, there is no indication of any rank, do you know the name of --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Unfortunately, I don't believe so, because in fact that person was working as a UN interpreter, was in the army at that time I think as a simple soldier, and I met a few of them but off records, since all -- I met three of them in total and the three of them had indicated me that them and their families have been threatened if ever they gave any statement to the ICTY and I honestly don't remember. I remember the name of one of them but not the -- he had not been threatened but to the two others, I don't know if I have any record of the meeting that I had with them. Also, regarding the name of the witness that was interviewed and who was detained on the soccer field, to find the name I would need to have access to the records of the team or be authorised to have contact with one person who is now busy with these archives, in order to get the name out of these archives.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Do you insist any further on your submission, Mr. Ostojic?

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Not at this time, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you, yes, Mr. McCloskey, you may proceed, I think.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. I will try to stay away from unnamed sources. But there is a logistical problem.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I understand.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We of course are not speaking to Mr. Ruez. If you would like us to get that information we can but we may need that little contact with Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: That's why I asked Mr. Ostojic if he envisioned but I think at this time you can safely proceed with the next question and then we will deal with this problem, if it is a problem, if and when it arises.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to 29. Now we see another aerial photograph. Mr. Ruez, what is this of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the designed to have a clearer view of the environment and go from a black and white aerial imagery to a colour picture shot from helicopter. It is an extract of the helicopter flight video that you will see -- you saw some footages of and you will see some more of them. So on the right of this picture is the soccer field.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. I was just going to ask you, remember question/answer. Where the little hand is just going around, what is that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the soccer field of Nova Kasaba.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Just to orient the -- from bottom to top, what direction is that going in?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The road going north is entering Nova Kasaba and the road going south leads to the intersection of Konjevic Polje -- I mean, going south of the picture because in reality it's the opposite. The top of the picture is south and the bottom of the picture is direction north towards Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot. And what is this, number 30?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a photograph taken -- I took in April 1996, showing the soccer field of Nova Kasaba seen from the ground, grounds level.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to 31. Now, which site are we going to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a detention site at Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 32. And we have another US aerial image. Can you tell us what this depicts?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The photograph shows a facility which is a former school and that was the base of the 5th engineer Battalion of the Drina Corps, where the circle is, is a little guard hut that witness 35 described as being the first spot he was taken to when he surrendered in that area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 33. And what is 33?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is again the base of the 5th engineer Battalion, and at the left of the picture you can see the guard house.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to the next shot, 34. And what is this picture generally?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So again this picture shows the intersection of Konjevic Polje, the road going to the north, the top of the picture is direction Zvornik. To the right of the picture, direction Bratunac. To the bottom left, so to the south, direction Nova Kasaba.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And you've circled a building. What's this -- what's that building's significance to the investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Witness 35 declared that after having been taken to the guard house, he was then put inside a hangar that was at the intersection. So we have a photograph of a hangar at this intersection. This one is taken in April 1997. I took it. Later, this place was erased and a gas station was constructed on that spot. So it's more or less the only picture we have of this hangar.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 35. Ground shot. What is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. That's a ground picture that was not designed in fact to show this hangar but it's the second picture that we have. So we only have two. This one was taken by me in April 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And which is the -- what building is the hangar?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The hangar is the building at the left of the picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to -- okay. Now the outline has got a little video segment entitled, "Kamenica, ambush down to Sandici." We will play that now but can you just give us a briefing of what this is of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The video will start with a helicopter mission that was done by the US army on my request, pin pointing an area on the map that we name Kamenica. That is a location named by several of those who walked through the woods, and designated as a point where an ambush, a major ambush, occurred, spreading panic among the people.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And [indiscernible] them --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: This is what he should be avoiding and where he should stop. Let's not have a repetition of it.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: But nevertheless --

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, we are in a different world now than we have been so please just answer my question and we've -- we'll just go one step at a time. I know you're trying hard. Okay. So this --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Put your mind at rest, Defence teams. It's as if this has never been stated, as far as we are concerned. So that's our position.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So can -- so what's the video of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It will then show a road that is the road that goes from the top of the hill towards the asphalt road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And along that road at one point one could stop the picture and show two storey house that is a reference point for two major witnesses who will come and testify.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And then there will be a piece of footage of our first arrival at the Sandici meadow. It's an aerial footage.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: This is 65 ter 1590.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So what's the significance of these areas that you're being zoomed in and out on?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is showing the area of Kamenica. That's the hill that is on the opposite side of the asphalt road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And the pilot is filming remains.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. We had a -- back a little bit further we had some white section in the middle of the -- right there at 53.0. All right. Keep going.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is the road that will then lead down towards the so-called asphalt road, the road Bratunac-Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Sorry, we lost a little video there. Don't know what the problem is. Sometimes Sanction does that. We are obviously repeating.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Now we've just switched from aerial to ground. Can you explain that switch?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is in order to show the direction that those who say have surrendered in that area took in order to go downhill towards the asphalt road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's continue. That was at 1.33.2.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The voice is the voice of a colleague named Peter Nicholson. Stop. We might see the house now. Yes, he's zooming on it. This is it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay, there is a white house in the middle of the frame. What's the significance of that for the investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We call it the two storage house not to make any confusion with the house in Potocari. This is the direction that the people who went down hill took. Then they walked at the edge of this house. This house can be seen on the Zoran Petrovic video at several occasions.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Sorry, we hear a voice on the film that's -- what's he -- what's he talking about?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We should just listen to him. He's saying that we are going downhill, that here is the house.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So he's just describing what he sees?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: He's describing what he's filming, indeed. It was a way for us to record our information when we couldn't do it in written form. We were using video.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And who is Peter Nicholson?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Peter Nicholson was working for the Office of the Prosecutor and he was one of the few persons who went away from their duties in 1996 in order to accompany me on the mission area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you. Let's continue.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Here at the left is the way up towards the house. This is the so-called Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. So on this video it's at 02.39.5, just a bit before that.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: When was this shot?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm not sure. It was in 1996, probably -- yes, it was in June of 1996.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is the way that the prisoners who can be seen on the Zoran Petrovic video were walking along and leaving personal belongings.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: About 5.53.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Here again the road they went down.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, one moment, Mr. McCloskey. Mr. Bourgon?

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. I would just like to know if we have a transcript of that particular video because this time I could understand but many other people could not understand what was being said on the video.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: No there is not a transcript. They have had this video for a very long time. And it was clear and it's again this is like a --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: But the problem that has been made is that it is not -- there is no transcript in B/C/S. In other words, that it is -- it can be understood by the English-speaking ones but not by the others.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President, that's in all due respect what they have translation assistance for. If there was something of major significance on that we would have provided it. Didn't think there was. So if we can get that translated, and if necessary, but what you're seeing basically is what he described. This is what the film they shot as they received. They've had this for a long time. I've not received a request tore this. We can, of course, provide that if it's now of interest.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Madam Fauveau?

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Mr. President --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: You're not Madam Fauveau.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Excuse me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Madam Fauveau.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There is something in French that I'm not sure what was said in English but in English we saw a document on the screen on the monitor and this was translated by an identity card and an ID and I think it is actually a permit for a weapon so I don't know what's said in English but it is rather important.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Certainly. When we have these problems, which I encountered obviously before in other cases, the way we solved it and it was a more practical approach than having it translated in the form of a transcript, was to give instructions that while we are seeing the footage and while these words are being uttered by whoever is on the other side of the screen, the interpreters translate or -- interpret -- go ahead with interpreting the words into the various languages that we have, in this case it will be French and Serbo-Croat. So what I can suggest at this point in time is either of two options. One is having the -- this part, transcript, translated into B/C/S. I think that would meet the concerns of all the non-speaking ones and that would be also including Madam Fauveau, just in case she has problems there. The other alternative is that we go back, we start this footage again, and we listen to the words, maybe we can raise the volume, and have it interpreted live in real time while we watch it. That's another possibility. So I leave the option to you, Mr. McCloskey. The second alternative would spare you both the expense of having it translated and also the time involved. How long has this been reeling, do you know?

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Seven minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: How long is this video footage?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: It's another 8 minutes more is that total eight minutes? It's 8.42. Your Honour, that's a lot to ask the interpreters. Normally when we do it that way we've given them a transcript. If they think they can I'm willing to try that. I also don't have a problem with turning the sound off because it's really not what we would like is just the -- see the places you've just seen in the Petrovic film.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. If the sound or the words spoken by Mr. Nicholson are not important for you, yes, we can do it that way, but I think the witness told you, you just listened to what Mr. Nicholson is saying. So you just have to listen to him. So I don't know. It's your choice, Mr. McCloskey. For us, if they are not important for you, they may not be so important for us. I don't know. I wouldn't want to commit myself.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: If we can turn the sound off, that's fine with me.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: If nobody else is going to respond, I think that's an excellent suggestion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I think we can live with that. Yes, let's proceed along those lines, then. Sound off. And let's continue with the footage, and please, you try to explain to us what we are seeing. In other words, pretend you are Mr. Nicholson.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. The only problem with cutting the sound is that at the beginning of the video most of the time Peter Nicholson gives dates, precise dates. And I might have difficulties to be sure of the date.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We can provide that information later. Frankly, it's -- again that information can be provided. That's not a problem.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Yes. Go ahead. No sound.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Audio, I hope you can do that. That's not something we can control. They can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We can take this off and it will be no sound.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Audio, we have the thumbs up on the no audio and I guess we are starting over again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: But this we have seen already, no?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So can we -- can we go straight to where we had left it? I don't think we need to see this all over again.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I agree, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: It's over at that point, Mr. President, where we left off, so that's -- we shouldn't have a problem. We'll just delete any sound for this exhibit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, let's get back on track and left off with the video of the Sandici area. We've seen this, this shot. Okay. Now we are going to the next shot, let's go to 37. All right.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. This one we said we could skip because it would be covered by someone else, just a reference to an area to identify the place on the film.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's skip this, then, if we don't need to talk about it. We are now at 38. What is this of?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is again a view of the hills where the people were trying to find their way out and the road that leads towards the two storage house. It's again to show how the environment looked like, not too far in time from the date of the events.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's go to 39.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Same situation, this was seen on the -- on the film. It is the path of approach to this house that can be easily matched with some of the scenes of the so-called Zoran Petrovic video.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. Let's go to the next shot. Now we have another US aerial imagery. This one is described as group of people, Sandici, dated 13 July. This is number 40. So how does this relate to the -- to the various pictures we've seen? Sorry.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In fact, one more would be even better. So this is exactly the same one you just described with some additional markings.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. We are now on 41. And there are some yellow markings. Who did those markings?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: These ones were -- I don't know by who but these ones were prepared for the sake of preparation of the trial of General Krstic.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And the one marked 'destroyed house,' what's the significance of that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Starting from the top, the yellow dotted line shows in fact the reconstruction of the path that the people were taking before reaching the meadow. The label "destroyed house" is the two storage house we can see both on the film and on the picture that just showed. At the right, the destroyed houses are also a reference point once we see the meadow, both on my film and the one of Zoran Petrovic. According to the two witnesses whose name are number 37, as well as 36, the wounded were put in these houses. We don't know anything more than that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Let's stop there. And go on to the next.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, I'm sorry, I'm going to have to stop you. We've got to go very strict question and answer. And Your Honours, Mr. Ruez has something else he would like to explain on this. Do you mind in this situation if he is allowed to explain further?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Let's hear what he has to explain and then we'll decide as he goes along.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: There is one last marking that I didn't comment. It's the area that points to a circle labelled group of prisoners.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: All right. And is --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's then -- thank you, Mr. Ruez. Let's go to number 42. Is this related in -- to the previous 41?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is. This one is a closer zooming in that area where again one can recognise the two storage house. The road with some buses on it. Then the approach slope that leads to the Sandici meadow and the same type of mess that is supposed to represent groups of people, we saw the same on the Nova Kasaba soccer field.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: And that's from the information provided by the United States in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: In its label. Okay. Let's go to the next one. And what is this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a photograph that I took in 1997, summer 1997. I don't remember what month. The Sandici meadow had turned into a corn field. One can see at the left behind the HUMVEE to the left the approach path that we can see the prisoners took on the video of Zoran Petrovic, and the yellow area is an area that I have marked. That is approximately the area where the prisoners -- I mean where the group of people was sitting or standing and I did this marking in accordance to the aerial imagery we have seen before.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you. Okay. Let's go to number 44. And we see now a split image. Can you explain that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The picture at the bottom is the one I just commented previously, and the picture top left is an extract of the Zoran Petrovic video, and the little yellow square at the middle left of the picture pin points the precise location of where these people were at that moment in the film.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Is that based on your opinion of analysing these pictures?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Based on the fact that I went several times on this meadow and on the fact that I indeed looked at the Zoran Petrovic video more or less frame by frame.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Let's continue. Okay. We are going to the next area. And Mr. Ruez, which area are we going to now briefly or what's the significance of this number 45?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Now that we have reviewed the map where the dots meant detention sites, and I didn't talk about Bratunac and Potocari because we already talked about these locations. This map and the following ones will indicate areas where either alleged or proven executions took place.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And so I see this red mark above Vlasenica. What's the significance of that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this area, I have to find the number of the witness, witness 54 says that in the evening of the 13, he was taken on board of a little truck, driven towards -- from the Luke school towards Vlasenica then turned left direction north and after sometime arrived in a place where he says he managed to flee before being shot. We brought him back to the area and tried to find the alleged spot of that execution but we didn't find anything. Nor did we find any mass grave in this area, though there be explanations to that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: So what does this red dot signify then?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It just signifies the approximate area where this witness says this final event took place.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Let's go to the next shot. 46. We have now marked Konjevic Polje area or is this Cerska valley?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Cerska.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: It's right between. Okay. Let's go right to the next photograph, 47. And can you tell us what this is and orient us, please?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So this is a view taken from the 1998 helicopter flight, showing to the right the road that goes, if you turn around, at the top of the picture it would be towards the intersection of Konjevic Polje, and at the bottom, it would go to the south, to Nova Kasaba.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And the black arrow, where is that going?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The black arrow marks the gravel road that leads towards the Cerska valley.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. And what is the significance of the Cerska valley?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So --

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: To the investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: There is an in fact a series of witnesses who all have a different approach of the situation.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Let's not get into the witnesses. At this point, I don't think we need to. Can you tell us let's go on over on what you found in the area if it was based on what the witnesses told you?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So based on one witness account, who being on the big hill I showed previously, which is now on the right, out of the frame of the picture, that person saw three buses entering the valley, escorted by an APC. He then lost sight of it, which makes sense when we see --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Don't -- we don't require you to state whether this makes sense or doesn't make sense.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: That's not what you are here for.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So Mr. McCloskey. Was that what your objection was going to address?

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President, I think the question of my colleague was exactly to the point what did he find in Cerska and that's fine with us.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay. Based on this -- and I appreciate you providing the information. Based on the information you just described to us from this witness, and other information -- well, what -- let's just go to the next photograph. Obviously you've looked, investigated this area.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this photograph shows in fact the access to this valley from the gravel road that then will turn right towards the valley of Cerska.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This one shows again the approach of.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: This is 49 excuse me for interrupting?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Showing again the approach to the valley and the road narrowing.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Before we get into the valley I see that it's break time, Mr. President?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. I think we'll have to stop here for the day. Mr. Ruez, we will resume on Monday, Monday it's a morning sitting. Monday it's a morning sitting. And then we will take it up from there, all right? I don't know what the arrangements are for Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President, yes, Mr. Ruez indicated just briefly and he knows he's not supposed to talk to me but he has an administrative issue with his employer, that Mr. Ostojic and I heard about, just that there was a problem and we alerted that to the victim witness section but it may be something we can help him with in contacting his employer if that's all right. I wouldn't of course talk about anything else.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: The important thing is if you have a problem that needs to be attended to, it should be addressed by the registry, et cetera, but if it requires your assistance, I don't think there should be a problem with that. But at least try to avoid direct contact if that is not necessary. That's number 1. Number 2 is Mr. Ruez you've worked here for long years. You know what your duties are. You're not to discuss the subject of your testimony or these events with anyone between now and Monday when you resume your testimony. I thank you so much. I wish you all a nice weekend and we will reconvene Monday morning. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
